```{r mea-analysis-settings}
# ============================================================
#  MEA ORGANOID ANALYSIS — MASTER SCRIPT v5
#  Axion Biosystems Maestro | 12-well MEA plates
#  Spontaneous activity | Cortical & Thalamic organoids
# ============================================================
#
#  HOW TO USE THIS SCRIPT — ONLY 3 STEPS:
#
#  STEP 1: Set ROOT_FOLDER to your top-level MEA input folder
#  STEP 2: Fill in the experiment_table — one row per experiment folder
#  STEP 3: Run the whole script — everything else is automatic
#
#  PLOT LAYOUTS:
#  - Violin      : pooled per genotype | x-axis = age group + genotype combined
#  - Heatmaps    : ONE PNG per plate | all wells side by side incl. PBS
#  - Raster      : one panel per well (organoid) | top electrodes shown
#  - ISI         : pooled per genotype | age side by side | PBS overlaid
#
#  MEA GRID (Axion 12-well, 8x8 per well):
#  First digit = column (1=left → 8=right)
#  Second digit = row (1=bottom → 8=top)
#
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
library(readxl)
library(cowplot)   # for extracting legend as separate PNG
library(ggforce)   # for sina plots

# ============================================================
# ===   SECTION 1: USER SETTINGS (ONLY EDIT THIS SECTION)  ==
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 1: FOLDER PATHS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
ROOT_FOLDER   <- "input"
OUTPUT_FOLDER <- HTML_OUTPUT_FOLDER

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 2: EXPERIMENT TABLE
# One row per experiment folder.
# protocol      : "CORTEX" or "THALAMUS" — always analysed separately
# experiment_id : short label used in plot titles and filenames
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
experiment_table <- tribble(
  ~experiment_folder,          ~protocol,   ~experiment_id,
  "5_MEA_experiment_5-2026",   "CORTEX",    "Exp5",
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 3: GENOTYPE ORDER
# Order in which genotypes appear left-to-right within each age group.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
CORTEX_GENOTYPE_ORDER   <- c("WT/REV", "WT/GRN", "REV/REV", "GRN/GRN")
THALAMUS_GENOTYPE_ORDER <- c("WT/REV", "WT/GRN", "REV/REV", "GRN/GRN")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 4: GENOTYPE NAME HARMONISATION
# Map any spelling variants to the correct name.
# Left = what's in your metadata, Right = correct name.
# Now that metadata is corrected to REV/REV, this can be left empty
# or kept as a safety net.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
GENOTYPE_HARMONISE <- c(
  "RE/REV" = "REV/REV"   # safety net in case any old files still use RE/REV
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 5: PBS CONTROL IDENTIFIER
# String to detect PBS wells in the GENOTYPE column (case-insensitive).
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
PBS_LABEL <- "PBS"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 6: ANALYSIS TOGGLES
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
RUN_VIOLIN_AMPLITUDE  <- TRUE
RUN_VIOLIN_MFR        <- TRUE
RUN_HEATMAP_AMPLITUDE <- TRUE
RUN_HEATMAP_MFR       <- TRUE
RUN_RASTER            <- TRUE
RUN_ISI_RIDGELINE     <- TRUE

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# OPTIONAL: SUBSET FILTERS
# Leave NULL to include everything.
# PBS wells are always kept regardless of filters.
# Examples:
#   SUBSET_GENOTYPES   <- c("WT/REV", "WT/GRN")
#   SUBSET_AGES        <- c(10)
#   SUBSET_BATCHES     <- c(8)
#   SUBSET_EXPERIMENTS <- c("Exp4", "Exp5")
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
SUBSET_GENOTYPES   <- NULL
SUBSET_AGES        <- NULL
SUBSET_BATCHES     <- NULL
SUBSET_EXPERIMENTS <- NULL

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# OPTIONAL: RASTER SETTINGS
# N_RASTER_ELECTRODES: how many top electrodes to show per well
# RASTER_ELECTRODES: NULL = auto (top N most active per well)
#                    or specify manually: c("A1_34", "A1_44")
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
N_RASTER_ELECTRODES <- 5
RASTER_ELECTRODES   <- NULL
RASTER_START_TIME   <- 60
RASTER_END_TIME     <- 120

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# OPTIONAL: CUSTOM COLOUR PALETTE
# NULL = auto-generated. To override:
# CUSTOM_PALETTE <- c("WT/REV"  = "#0D47A1",
#                     "WT/GRN"  = "#43A047",
#                     "REV/REV" = "#E53935",
#                     "GRN/GRN" = "#FB8C00",
#                     "PBS"     = "grey60")
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
CUSTOM_PALETTE <- NULL

# ============================================================
# ===  END OF USER SETTINGS — DO NOT EDIT BELOW THIS LINE  ==
# ============================================================

if (!dir.exists(OUTPUT_FOLDER)) dir.create(OUTPUT_FOLDER, recursive = TRUE)

emit_saved_png <- function(fname) {
  rel_path <- utils::URLencode(basename(fname), reserved = TRUE)
  cat("\n\n")
  cat(paste0("**Saved PNG:** [", basename(fname), "](", rel_path, ")\n\n"))
  cat(paste0("<img src=\"", rel_path,
             "\" alt=\"", basename(fname),
             "\" style=\"max-width:100%; height:auto;\" />\n\n"))
  invisible(fname)
}

```

```{r file-discovery-loading-functions}
# ============================================================
# --- SECTION 2: FILE DISCOVERY & LOADING ---
# ============================================================

detect_header_rows <- function(filepath) {
  raw_lines  <- readLines(filepath, n = 200, warn = FALSE)
  header_row <- which(str_detect(raw_lines, "Time \\(s\\)"))[1]
  if (is.na(header_row)) stop(paste("Could not find 'Time (s)' in:", filepath))
  return(header_row - 1)
}

load_spike_file <- function(filepath) {
  skip_n <- detect_header_rows(filepath)
  read_csv(filepath, skip = skip_n, show_col_types = FALSE, name_repair = "unique") %>%
    select(any_of(c("Time (s)", "Electrode", "Amplitude (mV)"))) %>%
    setNames(c("time_s", "electrode_id", "amplitude_mv")) %>%
    mutate(
      time_s       = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(time_s)),
      amplitude_mv = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(amplitude_mv))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(time_s), !is.na(amplitude_mv)) %>%
    separate(electrode_id, into = c("well", "electrode_num"),
             sep = "_", remove = FALSE, extra = "merge") %>%
    mutate(
      mea_col      = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_sub(electrode_num, 1, 1))),
      mea_row      = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_sub(electrode_num, 2, 2))),
      amplitude_uv = amplitude_mv * 1000
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(mea_row), !is.na(mea_col)) %>%
    select(time_s, electrode_id, well, mea_row, mea_col, amplitude_uv)
}

load_metadata_xlsx <- function(filepath) {
  raw        <- read_xlsx(filepath, col_names = FALSE)
  row_labels <- as.character(raw[[1]])
  
  well_row_idx <- which(str_trim(str_to_upper(row_labels)) == "MEA WELL")[1]
  if (is.na(well_row_idx)) stop(paste("Could not find 'MEA WELL' row in:", filepath))
  
  wells   <- as.character(raw[well_row_idx, -1])
  wells   <- wells[!is.na(wells) & wells != "NA"]
  n_wells <- length(wells)
  
  get_row <- function(label) {
    idx <- which(str_trim(str_to_upper(row_labels)) == str_to_upper(label))[1]
    if (is.na(idx)) return(rep(NA_character_, n_wells))
    vals <- as.character(raw[idx, 2:(n_wells + 1)])
    vals[vals == "NA"] <- NA_character_
    vals
  }
  
  tibble(
    well       = wells,
    recorded   = get_row("RECORDED"),
    genotype   = get_row("GENOTYPE"),
    protocol   = get_row("PROTOCOL"),
    age_weeks  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(get_row("AGE (WEEKS)"))),
    batch      = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(get_row("BATCH"))),
    n_organoid = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(get_row("#ORGANOID"))),
    n_slice    = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(get_row("#SLICE")))
  ) %>%
    filter(is.na(recorded) | str_to_upper(recorded) == "TRUE")
}

discover_plate_files <- function(exp_folder_path, experiment_id, protocol) {
  meta_files <- list.files(exp_folder_path, pattern = "\\.xlsx$",
                           full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
  if (length(meta_files) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No .xlsx metadata files found in:", exp_folder_path))
    return(NULL)
  }
  results <- list()
  subfolders    <- list.dirs(exp_folder_path, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
  for (meta_path in meta_files) {
    meta_filename <- basename(meta_path)
    plate_match   <- str_extract(str_to_lower(meta_filename), "plate\\d+")
    if (is.na(plate_match)) {
      warning(paste("Could not extract plate number from:", meta_filename)); next
    }
    plate_folders <- subfolders[str_detect(str_to_lower(basename(subfolders)), fixed(plate_match))]
    if (length(plate_folders) == 0) {
      warning(paste("No MEAplate subfolder matching", plate_match, "in:", experiment_id)); next
    }
    plate_folder <- plate_folders[1]
    all_csv      <- list.files(plate_folder, pattern = "\\.csv$",
                               full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
    spont_list   <- all_csv[str_detect(str_to_lower(basename(all_csv)), "spont") &
                              str_detect(str_to_lower(basename(all_csv)), "spike_list")]
    if (length(spont_list) == 0)
      spont_list <- all_csv[str_detect(str_to_lower(basename(all_csv)), "spont")]
    if (length(spont_list) == 0) {
      warning(paste("No spont spike_list csv found in:", basename(plate_folder))); next
    }
    spike_path <- spont_list[1]
    plate_id   <- paste0(experiment_id, "_", str_to_upper(plate_match))
    results[[plate_id]] <- list(
      plate_id      = plate_id,
      experiment_id = experiment_id,
      protocol      = protocol,
      meta_path     = meta_path,
      spike_path    = spike_path
    )
    cat(paste0("  Found [", plate_id, "]\n",
               "    Metadata : ", meta_filename, "\n",
               "    Spikes   : ", basename(spike_path), "\n"))
  }
  return(results)
}
```

# Load and Prepare Data

```{r load-data}
# Load all experiments
all_data_list <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(experiment_table))) {
  exp_row  <- experiment_table[i, ]
  exp_path <- file.path(ROOT_FOLDER, exp_row$experiment_folder)
  cat(paste0("\nScanning: ", exp_row$experiment_id, " [", exp_row$protocol, "]\n"))
  if (!dir.exists(exp_path)) { warning(paste("Folder not found:", exp_path)); next }
  plate_files <- discover_plate_files(exp_path, exp_row$experiment_id, exp_row$protocol)
  if (is.null(plate_files) || length(plate_files) == 0) next
  for (plate in plate_files) {
    cat(paste0("\n  Loading: ", plate$plate_id, " ...\n"))
    tryCatch({
      meta <- load_metadata_xlsx(plate$meta_path) %>%
        mutate(plate_id = plate$plate_id, experiment_id = plate$experiment_id,
               protocol = plate$protocol)
      spikes   <- load_spike_file(plate$spike_path)
      combined <- spikes %>%
        left_join(meta, by = "well") %>%
        mutate(plate_id = plate$plate_id, experiment_id = plate$experiment_id,
               protocol = plate$protocol)
      all_data_list[[plate$plate_id]] <- combined
      cat(paste0("  ✓ ", format(nrow(combined), big.mark = ","), " spikes | ",
                 n_distinct(combined$well), " wells\n"))
    }, error = function(e) warning(paste("Error loading", plate$plate_id, ":", e$message)))
  }
}

all_data_raw <- bind_rows(all_data_list)
if (nrow(all_data_raw) == 0) stop("\nNo data loaded. Check ROOT_FOLDER and file names.\n")

# Harmonise genotype names
if (length(GENOTYPE_HARMONISE) > 0) {
  all_data_raw <- all_data_raw %>%
    mutate(genotype = recode(genotype, !!!GENOTYPE_HARMONISE))
  cat("\nGenotype harmonisation applied:\n")
  for (nm in names(GENOTYPE_HARMONISE))
    cat(paste0("  '", nm, "' → '", GENOTYPE_HARMONISE[nm], "'\n"))
}

# Robust PBS detection (handles NA genotypes)
all_data_raw <- all_data_raw %>%
  mutate(is_control = case_when(
    is.na(genotype) ~ FALSE,
    str_detect(str_to_upper(genotype), str_to_upper(PBS_LABEL)) ~ TRUE,
    TRUE ~ FALSE
  ))

# PBS diagnostic
pbs_wells <- all_data_raw %>% filter(is_control) %>% distinct(plate_id, well, genotype)
cat(paste0("\nPBS control wells detected: ", nrow(pbs_wells), "\n"))
if (nrow(pbs_wells) > 0) print(pbs_wells) else {
  cat("  ⚠ WARNING: No PBS wells found! Check GENOTYPE column in metadata.\n")
  cat("  Unique genotypes found:\n")
  print(sort(unique(all_data_raw$genotype)))
}

# Apply subset filters (PBS always kept)
all_data <- all_data_raw
if (!is.null(SUBSET_GENOTYPES))   all_data <- all_data %>% filter(genotype %in% SUBSET_GENOTYPES | is_control)
if (!is.null(SUBSET_AGES))        all_data <- all_data %>% filter(age_weeks %in% SUBSET_AGES | is_control)
if (!is.null(SUBSET_BATCHES))     all_data <- all_data %>% filter(batch %in% SUBSET_BATCHES | is_control)
if (!is.null(SUBSET_EXPERIMENTS)) all_data <- all_data %>% filter(experiment_id %in% SUBSET_EXPERIMENTS | is_control)
```

```{r data-loading, results='asis'}
# Build colour palette
get_genotype_order <- function(protocol) {
  if (str_to_upper(protocol) == "CORTEX") CORTEX_GENOTYPE_ORDER else THALAMUS_GENOTYPE_ORDER
}

all_non_ctrl     <- unique(all_data$genotype[!all_data$is_control])
preferred_order  <- unique(c(CORTEX_GENOTYPE_ORDER, THALAMUS_GENOTYPE_ORDER))
all_non_ctrl     <- c(preferred_order[preferred_order %in% all_non_ctrl],
                      all_non_ctrl[!all_non_ctrl %in% preferred_order])
all_ctrl         <- unique(all_data$genotype[all_data$is_control])

if (!is.null(CUSTOM_PALETTE)) {
  palette_colors <- CUSTOM_PALETTE
} else {
  base_colors    <- c("#0D47A1", "#43A047", "#E53935", "#FB8C00",
                      "#8E24AA", "#00ACC1", "#F4511E", "#6D4C41")
  palette_colors <- setNames(
    c(base_colors[seq_along(all_non_ctrl)], rep("grey60", length(all_ctrl))),
    c(all_non_ctrl, all_ctrl)
  )
  }
```

```{r helper-functions}
# ============================================================
# --- SECTION 3: HELPERS ---
# ============================================================

get_pbs_threshold <- function(df) {
  pbs <- df %>% filter(is_control)
  if (nrow(pbs) == 0) { warning("No PBS wells. Threshold = 0."); return(0) }
  thresh <- mean(pbs$amplitude_uv, na.rm = TRUE) + 3 * sd(pbs$amplitude_uv, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(paste0("  PBS threshold: ", round(thresh, 2), " µV\n"))
  thresh
}

age_label <- function(age) paste0(age, " wk")

# Shared heatmap theme
heatmap_theme <- function() {
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      axis.title       = element_blank(),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 7, color = "grey50"),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "grey80"),
      panel.grid       = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing    = unit(0.5, "lines"),
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"),
      legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
    )
}

# Shared heatmap scales
# col 1 left → col 8 right | row 1 top → row 8 bottom (matches viability display)
heatmap_scales <- function() {
  list(
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = NULL, limits = c(0.5, 8.5), position = "top"),
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = NULL, limits = c(0.5, 8.5)),  # row 1 at top
    coord_equal()
  )
}
```

```{r analysis-function-violin-amplitude, results='asis'}
# ============================================================
# --- SECTION 4: ANALYSIS FUNCTIONS ---
# ============================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# PART 1: AMPLITUDE VIOLIN PLOT
# One PNG per age | x-axis = WT/REV | WT/GRN | REV/REV | GRN/GRN | PBS
# Independent y-axis per age plot | pooled per genotype
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
run_violin <- function(df, protocol_name) {
  cat(paste0("\n[", protocol_name, "] Part 1: Violin plots (one per age)...\n"))
  
  geno_order <- get_genotype_order(protocol_name)
  thresh     <- get_pbs_threshold(df)
  
  # PBS label
  pbs_label_clean <- unique(df$genotype[df$is_control])
  pbs_label_clean <- pbs_label_clean[!is.na(pbs_label_clean)][1]
  
  # Full x-axis order: genotypes + PBS at end
  full_order <- c(geno_order, pbs_label_clean)
  
  # Expand palette to include PBS
  plot_palette <- palette_colors
  if (!is.null(pbs_label_clean) && !pbs_label_clean %in% names(plot_palette)) {
    plot_palette[pbs_label_clean] <- "grey60"
  }
  
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(genotype), genotype %in% full_order) %>%
    mutate(genotype = factor(genotype, levels = full_order))
  
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) { cat("  ⚠ No data. Skipping.\n"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  
  ages_sorted <- sort(unique(plot_df$age_weeks))
  
  # Generate one plot per age
  for (age in ages_sorted) {
    age_df <- plot_df %>% filter(age_weeks == age)
    
    if (nrow(age_df) == 0) next
    
    # Drop genotypes not present at this age (keeps x-axis clean)
    genos_present <- full_order[full_order %in% unique(age_df$genotype)]
    age_df <- age_df %>%
      mutate(genotype = factor(genotype, levels = genos_present))
    
    plot_sample <- age_df %>% sample_n(min(20000, nrow(age_df)))
    
    # --- Count organoids and slices per genotype ---
    # #ORGANOID = organoid ID (same ID across plates = same physical organoid)
    # #SLICE    = slice ID (each well with an organoid = one slice)
    # So: n_organoids = unique organoid IDs (regardless of plate)
    #     n_slices    = number of wells with n_organoid > 0
    counts_df <- age_df %>%
      distinct(plate_id, well, genotype, n_organoid) %>%
      filter(n_organoid > 0) %>%   # exclude PBS wells
      group_by(genotype) %>%
      summarise(
        total_organoids = n_distinct(n_organoid),   # unique organoid IDs
        total_slices    = n(),                       # each row = one well = one slice
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        genotype    = factor(genotype, levels = genos_present),
        count_label = paste0("n = ", total_organoids, " org\n",
                             total_slices, " slices")
      )
    
    p <- ggplot(age_df, aes(x = genotype, y = amplitude_uv, fill = genotype)) +
      geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7, scale = "width", bw = 1) +
      geom_jitter(data = plot_sample, width = 0.2, alpha = 0.08,
                  size = 0.4, color = "black") +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = thresh, linetype = "dashed",
                 color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
      # Count labels placed just below x-axis ticks
      geom_text(data = counts_df,
                aes(x = genotype, y = -5, label = count_label),
                size = 4.5, fontface = "italic", color = "grey30",
                lineheight = 0.9, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) {
        # PBS = plain, genotypes = italic (using plotmath expressions)
        labs <- ifelse(str_detect(str_to_upper(x), "PBS"),
                       as.character(x),
                       paste0("italic('", x, "')"))
        parse(text = labs)
      }) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = plot_palette) +
      # Extra bottom margin so count labels don't get clipped
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-12, 45),
                         breaks  = seq(0, 45, by = 10),
                         labels  = seq(0, 45, by = 10)) +
      coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
      labs(
        title   = NULL,   # no big title
        x       = NULL,
        y       = "Amplitude (µV)",
        caption = paste0(age, " weeks | Dashed = PBS threshold (mean+3SD = ",
                         round(thresh, 1), " µV)")
      ) +
      # --- LETTER SIZES: change base_size for overall scaling ---
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(
        plot.margin     = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 40, l = 10),
        axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        # Note: x-axis labels use plotmath — genotypes italic, PBS plain
        axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
        plot.caption    = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid      = element_blank(),
        panel.border    = element_rect(color = "grey80", fill = NA)
      )
    
    fname <- file.path(OUTPUT_FOLDER,
                       paste0(protocol_name, "_1_violin_amplitude_",
                              age, "wk.png"))
    ggsave(fname, plot = p,
           width  = max(6, length(genos_present) * 1.5),
           height = 6, dpi = 300)
    emit_saved_png(fname)
    cat(paste0("  ✓ Saved: ", basename(fname), "\n"))
  }
}
```

```{r analysis-function-violin-mfr, results='asis'}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# PART 1b: MFR SINA PLOT
# Active electrodes coloured | inactive grey | fixed log y 0.01–0.5 Hz
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
run_violin_mfr <- function(df, protocol_name) {
  cat(paste0("\n[", protocol_name, "] Part 1b: MFR sina plots (one per age)...\n"))
  
  geno_order <- get_genotype_order(protocol_name)
  pbs_label_clean <- unique(df$genotype[df$is_control])
  pbs_label_clean <- pbs_label_clean[!is.na(pbs_label_clean)][1]
  full_order      <- c(geno_order, pbs_label_clean)
  
  plot_palette <- palette_colors
  if (!is.null(pbs_label_clean) && !pbs_label_clean %in% names(plot_palette))
    plot_palette[pbs_label_clean] <- "grey60"
  
  durations <- df %>%
    group_by(plate_id, well) %>%
    summarise(duration_s = max(time_s, na.rm = TRUE) - min(time_s, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop")
  
  mfr_df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(genotype), genotype %in% full_order) %>%
    group_by(plate_id, well, genotype, age_weeks,
             is_control, n_organoid, electrode_id) %>%
    summarise(n_spikes = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(durations, by = c("plate_id", "well")) %>%
    mutate(mfr_hz   = n_spikes / duration_s,
           genotype = factor(genotype, levels = full_order))
  
  if (nrow(mfr_df) == 0) { cat("  ⚠ No data. Skipping.\n"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  
  # PBS threshold
  pbs_mfr    <- mfr_df %>% filter(is_control)
  thresh_mfr <- if (nrow(pbs_mfr) > 0)
    mean(pbs_mfr$mfr_hz, na.rm = TRUE) + 3 * sd(pbs_mfr$mfr_hz, na.rm = TRUE) else NA
  if (!is.na(thresh_mfr))
    cat(paste0("  PBS MFR threshold: ", round(thresh_mfr, 4), " Hz\n"))
  
  # Tag active vs inactive
  mfr_df <- mfr_df %>%
    mutate(is_active = !is.na(thresh_mfr) & mfr_hz > thresh_mfr)
  
  ages_sorted <- sort(unique(mfr_df$age_weeks[!mfr_df$is_control]))
  
  for (age in ages_sorted) {
    age_df <- mfr_df %>% filter(age_weeks == age)
    if (nrow(age_df) == 0) next
    
    genos_present <- full_order[full_order %in% unique(age_df$genotype)]
    age_df        <- age_df %>% mutate(genotype = factor(genotype, levels = genos_present))
    inactive_df   <- age_df %>% filter(!is_active)
    active_df     <- age_df %>% filter(is_active)
    
    counts_df <- age_df %>%
      distinct(plate_id, well, genotype, n_organoid) %>%
      filter(n_organoid > 0) %>%
      group_by(genotype) %>%
      summarise(total_organoids = n_distinct(n_organoid),
                total_slices    = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(genotype    = factor(genotype, levels = genos_present),
             count_label = paste0("n = ", total_organoids, " org\n",
                                  total_slices, " slices"))
    
    median_df <- active_df %>%
      group_by(genotype) %>%
      summarise(median_mfr = median(mfr_hz, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
    
    p <- ggplot(age_df, aes(x = genotype, y = mfr_hz)) +
      # inactive electrodes — grey behind
      ggforce::geom_sina(data = inactive_df,
                         color = "grey75", alpha = 0.3,
                         size = 0.8, maxwidth = 0.7) +
      # active electrodes — colored in front
      ggforce::geom_sina(data = active_df,
                         aes(color = genotype),
                         alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2, maxwidth = 0.7) +
      # median of active electrodes
      geom_crossbar(data = median_df,
                    aes(x = genotype, y = median_mfr,
                        ymin = median_mfr, ymax = median_mfr),
                    width = 0.4, color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
      # PBS threshold line
      { if (!is.na(thresh_mfr))
        geom_hline(yintercept = thresh_mfr, linetype = "dashed",
                   color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) } +
      # counts below x-axis
      geom_text(data = counts_df,
                aes(x = genotype, y = 0.007, label = count_label),
                size = 4.5, fontface = "italic", color = "grey30",
                lineheight = 0.9, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) {
        labs <- ifelse(str_detect(str_to_upper(x), "PBS"),
                       as.character(x),
                       paste0("italic('", x, "')"))
        parse(text = labs)
      }) +
      scale_color_manual(values = plot_palette) +
      scale_y_log10(limits = c(0.01, 0.5),
                    breaks = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.5),
                    labels = c("0.01", "0.05", "0.1", "0.5"),
                    oob    = scales::squish) +
      coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean Firing Rate (Hz, log scale)",
           caption = paste0("Each point = one electrode | ",
                            "Gray = below PBS threshold | ",
                            "Colored = active (>", round(thresh_mfr, 4),
                            " Hz) | Bar = median of active electrodes")) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(plot.margin     = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 40, l = 10),
            axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
            axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 11),
            axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
            plot.caption    = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey40"),
            legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid      = element_blank(),
            panel.border    = element_rect(color = "grey80", fill = NA))
    
    fname <- file.path(OUTPUT_FOLDER,
                       paste0(protocol_name, "_1b_sina_mfr_", age, "wk.png"))
    ggsave(fname, plot = p,
           width  = max(6, length(genos_present) * 1.5),
           height = 6, dpi = 300)
    emit_saved_png(fname)
    cat(paste0("  ✓ Saved: ", basename(fname), "\n"))
  }
}
```

```{r analysis-function-heatmap-amplitude, results='asis'}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# PART 2: AMPLITUDE HEATMAP — ONE PNG PER WELL
# Scale: per-plate 2nd–98th percentile | legend per plate | no titles
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
run_heatmap_amplitude <- function(df, protocol_name) {
  cat(paste0("\n[", protocol_name, "] Part 2: Amplitude heatmaps (per well)...\n"))
  
  experiments <- unique(df$experiment_id)
  
  for (exp_id in experiments) {
    exp_df <- df %>% filter(experiment_id == exp_id)
    plates <- unique(exp_df$plate_id)
    
    # --- Save ONE legend per experiment ---
    # Show the overall experiment range for reference
    min_exp <- quantile(exp_df$amplitude_uv, 0.02, na.rm = TRUE)
    max_exp <- quantile(exp_df$amplitude_uv, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    legend_df <- tibble(x = 1, y = 1, fill = mean(c(min_exp, max_exp)))
    legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = fill)) +
      geom_point(shape = 21, size = 6) +
      scale_fill_gradient(
        low    = "lightblue", high = "red",
        limits = c(min_exp, max_exp), trans = "sqrt",
        name   = "Mean Amplitude (µV)\n2nd–98th percentile"
      ) +
      guides(fill = guide_colourbar(
        title.position = "top",    # title above bar
        title.hjust    = 0.5,      # centre title
        barwidth       = unit(8, "cm"),
        barheight      = unit(0.6, "cm"),
        ticks          = TRUE
      )) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(
        legend.position   = "bottom",
        legend.direction  = "horizontal",
        legend.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.text       = element_text(size = 11),
        legend.margin     = margin(t = 5)
      )
    legend_fname <- file.path(OUTPUT_FOLDER,
                              paste0(protocol_name, "_", exp_id,
                                     "_2_heatmap_amplitude_LEGEND.png"))
    ggsave(legend_fname,
           plot  = cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot) %>% cowplot::ggdraw(),
           width = 8, height = 2, dpi = 300)
    emit_saved_png(legend_fname)
    cat(paste0("  ✓ Legend saved: ", basename(legend_fname), "\n"))
    
    # --- Per-plate loop (scale per plate, one PNG per well) ---
    for (pid in plates) {
      plate_df <- exp_df %>% filter(plate_id == pid)
      
      # Per-plate 2nd–98th percentile scale
      min_a <- quantile(plate_df$amplitude_uv, 0.02, na.rm = TRUE)
      max_a <- quantile(plate_df$amplitude_uv, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)
      cat(paste0("  Plate ", pid, " scale: ",
                 round(min_a, 1), "–", round(max_a, 1), " µV\n"))
      
      well_list <- plate_df %>%
        distinct(plate_id, experiment_id, well, genotype, age_weeks, is_control) %>%
        arrange(well)
      
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(well_list))) {
        w         <- well_list[i, ]
        well_df   <- plate_df %>% filter(well == w$well)
        
        summary_df <- well_df %>%
          group_by(mea_row, mea_col) %>%
          summarise(mean_amplitude = mean(amplitude_uv, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
        
        if (nrow(summary_df) == 0) {
          cat(paste0("  ⚠ No data for ", pid, " ", w$well, ". Skipping.\n")); next
        }
        
        p <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = mea_col, y = mea_row)) +
          geom_point(aes(fill = mean_amplitude), shape = 21,
                     color = "black", size = 8) +
          heatmap_scales() +
          scale_fill_gradient(
            low    = "lightblue", high = "red",
            limits = c(min_a, max_a), trans = "sqrt",
            na.value = "white", oob = scales::squish
          ) +
          heatmap_theme() +
          labs(title = NULL) +
          theme(legend.position = "none")
        
        fname <- file.path(OUTPUT_FOLDER,
                           paste0(protocol_name, "_", exp_id, "_",
                                  pid, "_", w$well,
                                  "_2_heatmap_amplitude.png"))
        ggsave(fname, plot = p, width = 3, height = 3, dpi = 300)
        emit_saved_png(fname)
        cat(paste0("  ✓ Saved: ", basename(fname), "\n"))
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r analysis-function-heatmap-mfr, results='asis'}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# PART 3: MFR HEATMAP — ONE PNG PER WELL
# Scale: per-plate 2nd–98th percentile | legend per plate | no titles
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
run_heatmap_mfr <- function(df, protocol_name) {
  cat(paste0("\n[", protocol_name, "] Part 3: MFR heatmaps (per well)...\n"))
  
  # Recording duration per well — includes PBS wells
  durations <- df %>%
    group_by(plate_id, well) %>%
    summarise(duration_s = max(time_s, na.rm = TRUE) - min(time_s, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop")
  
  # MFR per electrode per well — includes PBS wells
  mfr_all <- df %>%
    group_by(plate_id, experiment_id, well, electrode_id, mea_row, mea_col) %>%
    summarise(total_spikes = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(durations, by = c("plate_id", "well")) %>%
    mutate(mfr_hz = total_spikes / duration_s)
  
  experiments <- unique(df$experiment_id)
  
  for (exp_id in experiments) {
    exp_mfr <- mfr_all %>% filter(experiment_id == exp_id)
    plates  <- unique(df$plate_id[df$experiment_id == exp_id])
    
    # --- Save ONE legend per experiment ---
    min_exp_mfr    <- quantile(exp_mfr$mfr_hz, 0.02, na.rm = TRUE)
    max_exp_mfr    <- quantile(exp_mfr$mfr_hz, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)
    median_exp_mfr <- median(exp_mfr$mfr_hz, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    legend_df <- tibble(x = 1, y = 1, fill = median_exp_mfr)
    legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = fill)) +
      geom_point(shape = 21, size = 6) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(
        low      = "darkgreen", mid = "lightyellow", high = "purple",
        midpoint = median_exp_mfr,
        limits   = c(min_exp_mfr, max_exp_mfr),
        name     = "Mean Firing Rate (Hz)\n2nd–98th percentile"
      ) +
      guides(fill = guide_colourbar(
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust    = 0.5,
        barwidth       = unit(8, "cm"),
        barheight      = unit(0.6, "cm"),
        ticks          = TRUE
      )) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(
        legend.position  = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.text      = element_text(size = 11),
        legend.margin    = margin(t = 5)
      )
    legend_fname <- file.path(OUTPUT_FOLDER,
                              paste0(protocol_name, "_", exp_id,
                                     "_3_heatmap_mfr_LEGEND.png"))
    ggsave(legend_fname,
           plot  = cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot) %>% cowplot::ggdraw(),
           width = 8, height = 2, dpi = 300)
    emit_saved_png(legend_fname)
    cat(paste0("  ✓ Legend saved: ", basename(legend_fname), "\n"))
    
    # --- Per-plate loop (scale per plate, one PNG per well) ---
    for (pid in plates) {
      plate_mfr <- exp_mfr %>% filter(plate_id == pid)
      if (nrow(plate_mfr) == 0) next
      
      # Per-plate 2nd–98th percentile scale
      min_mfr    <- quantile(plate_mfr$mfr_hz, 0.02, na.rm = TRUE)
      max_mfr    <- quantile(plate_mfr$mfr_hz, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)
      median_mfr <- median(plate_mfr$mfr_hz, na.rm = TRUE)
      cat(paste0("  Plate ", pid, " MFR scale: ",
                 round(min_mfr, 2), "–", round(max_mfr, 2), " Hz\n"))
      
      well_list <- df %>%
        filter(plate_id == pid) %>%
        distinct(plate_id, experiment_id, well, genotype, age_weeks, is_control) %>%
        arrange(well)
      
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(well_list))) {
        w      <- well_list[i, ]
        mfr_df <- plate_mfr %>% filter(well == w$well)
        
        if (nrow(mfr_df) == 0) {
          cat(paste0("  ⚠ No data for ", pid, " ", w$well, ". Skipping.\n")); next
        }
        
        p <- ggplot(mfr_df, aes(x = mea_col, y = mea_row)) +
          geom_point(aes(fill = mfr_hz), shape = 21,
                     color = "black", size = 8) +
          heatmap_scales() +
          scale_fill_gradient2(
            low      = "darkgreen", mid = "lightyellow", high = "purple",
            midpoint = median_mfr,
            limits   = c(min_mfr, max_mfr),
            na.value = "white", oob = scales::squish
          ) +
          heatmap_theme() +
          labs(title = NULL) +
          theme(legend.position = "none")
        
        fname <- file.path(OUTPUT_FOLDER,
                           paste0(protocol_name, "_", exp_id, "_",
                                  pid, "_", w$well,
                                  "_3_heatmap_mfr.png"))
        ggsave(fname, plot = p, width = 3, height = 3, dpi = 300)
        emit_saved_png(fname)
        cat(paste0("  ✓ Saved: ", basename(fname), "\n"))
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r analysis-function-raster, results='asis'}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# PART 4: RASTER PLOT
# One PNG per experiment | no title
# Top 3 electrodes per genotype stacked vertically
# Spikes colored by amplitude | clean publication layout
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
run_raster <- function(df, protocol_name) {
  cat(paste0("\n[", protocol_name, "] Part 4: Raster plots (per experiment)...\n"))
  
  geno_order      <- get_genotype_order(protocol_name)
  pbs_label_clean <- unique(df$genotype[df$is_control])
  pbs_label_clean <- pbs_label_clean[!is.na(pbs_label_clean)][1]
  full_order      <- c(geno_order, pbs_label_clean)
  
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(genotype), genotype %in% full_order) %>%
    mutate(genotype = factor(genotype, levels = full_order))
  
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) { cat("  ⚠ No data. Skipping.\n"); return(invisible(NULL)) }
  
  experiments <- unique(plot_df$experiment_id)
  
  for (exp_id in experiments) {
    exp_df <- plot_df %>% filter(experiment_id == exp_id)
    
    # Top 3 most active electrodes per genotype
    # Each electrode = one real physical electrode from one specific well
    top_elec <- exp_df %>%
      group_by(genotype, well, plate_id, electrode_id) %>%
      summarise(n_spikes = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      group_by(genotype) %>%
      slice_max(n_spikes, n = 3) %>%
      arrange(genotype, desc(n_spikes)) %>%
      mutate(elec_num = paste0("Electrode ", row_number())) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    cat(paste0("  [", exp_id, "] Top 3 electrodes per genotype:\n"))
    print(top_elec %>% select(genotype, electrode_id, well, plate_id,
                              n_spikes, elec_num))
    
    raster_df <- exp_df %>%
      inner_join(top_elec %>% select(genotype, electrode_id, well,
                                     plate_id, elec_num),
                 by = c("genotype", "electrode_id", "well", "plate_id")) %>%
      filter(time_s >= RASTER_START_TIME, time_s <= RASTER_END_TIME)
    
    if (nrow(raster_df) == 0) {
      cat(paste0("  ⚠ No data in time window for ", exp_id, ". Skipping.\n"))
      next
    }
    
    # Build y-axis factor: Electrode 1 at top, 3 at bottom per genotype
    y_levels <- top_elec %>%
      arrange(genotype, elec_num) %>%
      mutate(y_key = paste0(as.integer(genotype), "_", elec_num)) %>%
      pull(y_key) %>% rev()
    
    raster_df <- raster_df %>%
      mutate(y_key = factor(paste0(as.integer(genotype), "_", elec_num),
                            levels = y_levels))
    
    p <- ggplot(raster_df, aes(x = time_s, y = y_key)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = amplitude_uv), shape = "|", size = 4) +
      scale_color_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkred",
                           name = "Amplitude (µV)") +
      facet_grid(genotype ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
      scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_extract(x, "Electrode \\d+")) +
      labs(title = NULL,
           x = paste0("Time (s)  |  Window: ",
                      RASTER_START_TIME, "–", RASTER_END_TIME, " s"),
           y = NULL) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
      theme(
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 10),
        panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
        panel.spacing    = unit(1, "lines"),
        legend.position  = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"),
        legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10)
      )
    
    n_genos <- n_distinct(raster_df$genotype)
    fname   <- file.path(OUTPUT_FOLDER,
                         paste0(protocol_name, "_", exp_id,
                                "_4_raster_", RASTER_START_TIME, "s.png"))
    ggsave(fname, plot = p,
           width  = 12,
           height = max(6, n_genos * 2.5),
           dpi = 300)
    emit_saved_png(fname)
    cat(paste0("  ✓ Saved: ", basename(fname), "\n"))
  }
}
```

```{r analysis-function-isi, results='asis'}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# PART 5: ISI RIDGELINE PLOT
# One PNG per experiment | panels = genotype + PBS | y = age
# Burst window shaded (3–100ms) | spike count per ridge
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

run_isi <- function(df, protocol_name) {
  cat(paste0("\n[", protocol_name, "] Part 5: ISI ridgeline plots (per experiment)...\n"))
  
  geno_order <- get_genotype_order(protocol_name)
  thresh     <- get_pbs_threshold(df)
  
  experiments <- unique(df$experiment_id)
  
  for (exp_id in experiments) {
    exp_df <- df %>% filter(experiment_id == exp_id)
    
    # No PBS — genotypes only
    isi_df <- exp_df %>%
      filter(!is_control, !is.na(genotype), genotype %in% geno_order) %>%
      filter(amplitude_uv > thresh) %>%
      mutate(
        genotype  = factor(genotype, levels = geno_order),
        age_label = factor(age_label(age_weeks),
                           levels = rev(age_label(sort(unique(age_weeks)))))
      ) %>%
      group_by(genotype, age_label, electrode_id) %>%
      arrange(time_s, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(isi_ms = (time_s - lag(time_s)) * 1000) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      filter(!is.na(isi_ms), isi_ms > 0)
    
    if (nrow(isi_df) == 0) {
      cat(paste0("  ⚠ No ISI data for ", exp_id, ". Skipping.\n")); next
    }
    
    # Spike counts per genotype + age
    spike_counts <- isi_df %>%
      group_by(genotype, age_label) %>%
      summarise(n_isi = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(label = paste0("n=", format(n_isi, big.mark = ",")))
    
    n_ages <- n_distinct(isi_df$age_label)
    
    p <- ggplot(isi_df, aes(x = isi_ms, y = age_label, fill = genotype)) +
      
      # Burst window shading (3–100ms)
      annotate("rect",
               xmin = 3, xmax = 100,
               ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
               fill = "gold", alpha = 0.12) +
      
      # Ridgeline densities
      geom_density_ridges(
        alpha = 0.7, color = "black",
        scale = 1.5, rel_min_height = 0.01
      ) +
      
      # 3ms threshold line
      geom_vline(xintercept = 3, linetype = "dashed",
                 color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
      
      # 100ms line
      geom_vline(xintercept = 100, linetype = "dotted",
                 color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +
      
      # Spike count labels
      geom_text(data = spike_counts,
                aes(x = 12000, y = age_label, label = label),
                hjust = 1, vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5,
                color = "grey30", fontface = "italic",
                inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      
      # 2-row layout: WT/REV + WT/GRN on row 1, REV/REV + GRN/GRN on row 2
      facet_wrap(~ genotype, nrow = 2) +
      scale_x_log10(
        breaks = c(1, 3, 10, 100, 1000, 10000),
        labels = c("1", "3", "10", "100", "1k", "10k")
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = palette_colors) +
      labs(
        x       = "Inter-Spike Interval (ms, log scale)",
        y       = NULL,
        caption = "Dashed = 3 ms | Dotted = 100 ms | Shaded = burst window (3–100 ms) | Data pooled per genotype"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(
        strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
        axis.text.y        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        legend.position    = "none",
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
      )
    
    fname <- file.path(OUTPUT_FOLDER,
                       paste0(protocol_name, "_", exp_id,
                              "_5_isi_ridgeline.png"))
    ggsave(fname, plot = p,
           width  = max(8, 4.5 * 2),        # 2 columns
           height = max(6, n_ages * 2 * 2),  # 2 rows
           dpi = 300)
    emit_saved_png(fname)
    cat(paste0("  ✓ Saved: ", basename(fname), "\n"))
  }
}
```

```{r run-analyses, results='asis'}
# ============================================================
# --- SECTION 5: RUN ALL ANALYSES PER PROTOCOL ---
# ============================================================

for (proto in unique(all_data$protocol)) {
  cat('\n\n##', proto, "{.tabset}\n\n")
  cat(paste0("\n**Protocol: ", proto, "**\n"))
  
  proto_data <- all_data %>% filter(protocol == proto)
  if (nrow(proto_data) == 0) { cat("  ⚠ No data. Skipping.\n"); next }
  
  ages   <- sort(unique(proto_data$age_weeks[!proto_data$is_control]))
  genos  <- sort(unique(proto_data$genotype[!proto_data$is_control]))
  plates <- unique(proto_data$plate_id)
  
  cat(paste0("\n- Ages      : ", paste(ages, collapse = ", "), " weeks\n"))
  cat(paste0("- Genotypes : ", paste(genos, collapse = ", "), "\n"))
  cat(paste0("- Plates    : ", paste(plates, collapse = ", "), "\n\n"))

  cat('\n\n### Amplitude Violin Plots\n\n')
  if (RUN_VIOLIN_AMPLITUDE)  run_violin(proto_data, proto)
  cat("\n\n### MFR Violin Plots\n\n")
  if (RUN_VIOLIN_MFR)        run_violin_mfr(proto_data, proto)
  cat("\n\n### Amplitude Heatmap\n\n")
  if (RUN_HEATMAP_AMPLITUDE) run_heatmap_amplitude(proto_data, proto)
  cat("\n\n### MFR Heatmap\n\n")
  if (RUN_HEATMAP_MFR)       run_heatmap_mfr(proto_data, proto)
  cat("\n\n### Raster\n\n")
  if (RUN_RASTER)            run_raster(proto_data, proto)
  cat("\n\n### Interval\n\n")
  if (RUN_ISI_RIDGELINE)     run_isi(proto_data, proto)
}

cat(paste0("\n\n ✓ All done! Plots saved to:\n  ", OUTPUT_FOLDER, "\n"))
```
